title: DMZ blast was highly likely caused by North Korean mine, Seoul says

blocks.text: South Korea’s military said Monday that a North Korean land mine highly likely caused last week’s explosion inside the Demilitarized Zone that injured three officers, and vowed “corresponding measures” if North Korean troops are found to have planted it. The Joint Chiefs of Staff said fragments and other materials found after the Sept. 21 blast in the western section of the DMZ separating the two Koreas pointed to North Korea, as they did not match components typically used in South Korean mines.
